newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat steady on thin demand for spot grain.
newsitem.headline: French wheat steady on thin demand for spot grain.

text.p: French wheat prices were steady on Monday amid slow demand for spot grain, dealers said.
Wheat into Rouen was quoted at 855 francs per tonne for December delivery and 840 francs per tonne for January/March delivery, unchanged on Friday .
Prices may however get some support in coming weeks as buyers may seek fresh cover ahead of the Christmas recess, dealers said.
Wheat prices largely ignored news EU firms had applied through France to export a total of 942,000 tonnes of soft wheat to a target group of African nations.
Last Thursday the EU's grain committee set a special refund of 28 Ecus per tonne on wheat exports to the group of hard-pressed African nations. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
